Timeline CSS Generator

Build a vertical timeline from your events — live preview plus copy-ready HTML and CSS.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter one event per line (e.g. "2021 — Product launch").
  2. Pick the accent color and card style.
  3. Preview the timeline live.
  4. Copy the code or download the self-contained timeline.html file.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How should I format the events?

One per line. Put the date first, then a dash (–, — or -), then the event text. Lines without a dash still work — the whole line becomes the event text.

Is the timeline responsive?

Yes. The generated CSS keeps a single-column vertical timeline that works on mobile and desktop.

Can I use it inside an existing page?

Yes — copy the markup and the <style> block into your page. Class names are prefixed with tl- to avoid collisions.

What does the download include?

A complete standalone timeline.html file with the styles embedded, ready to open in a browser.
